title: 第27章 白蛇第28章 解决毒源的办法
content_zh:
“你们打算什么时候去对付那条蛇？”杨佳运好奇的看着郑元雪。
“你们知道那蛇的作息吗？”
“和我们作息一样这蛇一般都是白天活动，晚上盘踞在北侧最大的树上！”
“好！那我们就今天晚上行动，嘿嘿，我还想问管饭吗？我饿了！”
“呃！当然管饭，我现在就让他们做饭！”
杨佳运说完便出了大厅，只听他吆喝一句“备饭”屋外便开始忙碌起来，郑元雪无聊开始逗弄起小蛟龙来，杨修则是平心静气开始打坐修炼。
不过多时，杨佳运走进屋内通知杨修和郑元雪，让他们两个去吃饭，这让小蛟龙不满了吼叫了两声，杨佳运见状也明白了自己貌似漏了小蛟龙不好意思的说“不是熟食你可以吃吗？”
小蛟龙硕大的头颅点了点，表示自己可以接受，杨佳运松了一口气便说了句“跟我来！”
“啊！好久没有喝过热汤了，这段时间没有时间做汤！”郑元雪一脸惬意的开口道。
“不是没时间是咱俩都不会做”杨修出言直接将真相说了出来，引的郑元雪一阵脸红。
“吃好了吗？吃好了我们动身了？”杨佳运走过来问道。
“好啊！走本姑娘吃的好撑正好可以消化消化食物！”郑元雪拍了拍肚子又伸了伸懒腰。
“我也好了！”杨修则是冷冷开口。
“吼！”蛟龙没有说话只是叫了一声示意自己也可以了。
“你们等下我去拿灯！”杨佳运见两人准备好了连忙开心起身进了屋内，不一会儿便手提一盏灯笼出来。
“额？杨大哥其实你不用拿灯的！”郑元雪说了句，随后从储物戒中取出一颗珠子，珠子散发着光亮。
“这是夜明珠？”杨佳运惊讶的开口，在无垠大陆上夜明珠很稀有，因为这种珠子不是自然形成的，而是由火系修士死后很小的概率才能产生的。
“我可以看看嘛？”杨佳运想上手试一试夜明珠的手感迫不及待的说道。
“当然可以！你请我吃饭了！”郑元雪大大咧咧说着便把夜明珠递过去。
“原来是清凉的手感吗？我以为他会像火焰一样是温暖的呢！”杨佳运手不停在珠子上摸索表情也透露着他对这枚珠子的喜爱。

“既然杨大哥这么喜欢，这颗就送你了”郑元雪嘴角扬起开口道。
“这有点太珍贵了吧！我不能接受！”杨佳运手紧紧抓住夜明珠，脑袋摇了摇头表示拒绝。
“没事的！我父皇送了我两颗，一般都很少用送你一颗正好！别磨叽了我们走吧，打完收工！”
“好，那我就是恭敬不如从命了！你们跟紧我！”
“杨大哥你很喜欢夜明珠吗？”这时一直不开口的杨修疑惑道。
杨佳运摸了摸脸笑着开口“我从小就对珠子一类的东西感兴趣，算是个人爱好！”
因为郑元雪送礼物的行为让杨佳运对郑元雪的好感突飞猛进，两人一路上有说有笑的，杨修和小蛟龙就两人身后默默跟着不一会儿三人一兽便来到了毒雾的边缘。
“这毒雾这么浓郁已经影响到空气都变色了！”郑元雪看了看面前的紫色和无色的明显分界线开口说道。
content_en:
"When are you going to deal with that snake?" Yang Jiayun looked at Zheng Yuanxue curiously.
"Do you know the snake's routine?"
"Similar to our daily schedule, this snake is usually active during the day and stays on the largest tree on the north side at night!"
"Okay! Then we'll take action tonight. Hey, do I still want to ask the food manager? I'm hungry!"
"Uh! Of course I'm in charge of the food, I'll let them cook now!"
After Yang Jiayun finished speaking, he left the hall. He only heard him yell "prepare food" and things started to get busy outside. Zheng Yuanxue was bored and started teasing the little dragon, while Yang Xiu calmly began to meditate.
Not long after, Yang Jiayun walked into the house and informed Yang Xiu and Zheng Yuanxue that they should go to eat. This made the little dragon roar twice in dissatisfaction. When Yang Jiayun saw this, he also understood that he seemed to have missed something. The little dragon said embarrassedly, "Can you eat it if it's not cooked food?"
The little dragon nodded its huge head, indicating that he could accept it. Yang Jiayun breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Follow me!"
"Ah! I haven't had hot soup for a long time. I don't have time to make soup during this time!" Zheng Yuanxue said with a satisfied look on his face.
"It's not that we don't have time, it's that neither of us know how to do it." Yang Xiu directly told the truth, causing Zheng Yuanxue to blush.
"Have you eaten? Are we ready to leave?" Yang Jiayun came over and asked.
"Okay! This girl has eaten well and can digest the food!" Zheng Yuanxue patted her belly and stretched.
"I'm fine too!" Yang Xiuze said coldly.
"Roar!" Jiaolong didn't say anything but just shouted to indicate that he could do it.
"Wait a minute, I'll get the lantern!" Seeing that the two of them were ready, Yang Jiayun quickly got up happily and entered the house. After a while, he came out with a lantern in hand.
"Uh? Brother Yang, you don't actually need to hold a lamp!" Zheng Yuanxue said, and then took out a bead from the storage ring. The bead was shining brightly.
"Is this a luminous pearl?" Yang Jiayun said in surprise. The luminous pearl is very rare in the Infinite Continent, because this kind of pearl is not naturally formed, but is produced by a very small probability after the death of a fire monk.
"Can I have a look?" Yang Jiayun said eagerly, wanting to try out the feel of the Night Pearl.
"Of course! You invited me to dinner!" Zheng Yuanxue said carelessly and handed Ye Mingzhu over.
"Did it feel cool to the touch? I thought it would be as warm as a flame!" Yang Jiayun kept groping on the bead with his hands, and his expression revealed his love for the bead.
"Since Brother Yang likes it so much, I'll give this one to you," Zheng Yuanxue said with the corner of her mouth raised.
"This is a bit too precious! I can't accept it!" Yang Jiayun grasped Ye Mingzhu tightly and shook his head to express his rejection.
"It's okay! My father gave me two pills, and I rarely need to give you one. Just give me one! Stop being so nagging, let's go and call it a day!"
"Okay, then I'd rather be respectful than obey! You follow me closely!"
"Brother Yang, do you like Ye Mingzhu very much?" Yang Xiu, who had been silent at this time, asked doubtfully.
Yang Jiayun touched his face and said with a smile, "I have been interested in things like beads since I was a child. It's a personal hobby!"
Because of Zheng Yuanxue's act of giving gifts, Yang Jiayun's affection for Zheng Yuanxue increased rapidly. The two of them were talking and laughing along the way. Yang Xiu and Xiaolong followed silently behind them. After a while, the three of them and one beast came to the edge of the poisonous fog.
"This poisonous mist is so dense that it has affected the air and changed its color!" Zheng Yuanxue looked at the clear dividing line between purple and colorless in front of him and said.
